title: New World's twelve functions as synced block sets: one list drives the website, Spotlight, Space tab and email

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-04 07:11Z: full design evolution and polish pass for New World, fully developed to the design system (Kit Overview, record.js FUNCTIONS)

detail:
The design's Kit Overview draws each Frequency function as one synced block set: a website section, a Spotlight door, a Space tab and an email (ui_kits/site/record.js FUNCTIONS). The Spotlight content kept its own private copy of that list and the kit Home drew every section whatever the kit's tools, so the two could drift. lib/sites/new-world-functions.ts becomes the one list (each row names its block types, door, Space tab and email); the Spotlight builds its doors from it and newWorldHome keeps only the sections whose function the kit turns on, as the design's Home does, renumbering the numbered sections. Adds a NewWorldShop block so the shop is its own function on Home and Ways in.

lib/sites/new-world-functions.ts is the one function list: the Spotlight builds its doors from it and each New World kit's Home keeps only the sections its functions turn on (venues, hosts, nonprofits and networks drop open times and ways in; studios, hosts, venues and nonprofits gain the shop). Test lib/sites/new-world-functions.test.ts holds Home and Spotlight to the same set per kit.
